properties.title: Chandrayaan-2 CLASS L2 Elemental Abundance Map - Iron
properties.lri:data_use_note: Fe wt% derived from CLASS X-ray fluorescence spectra along sparse orbital ground tracks at a fixed 150 km (along-track) x 12.5 km (across-track) ground pixel size (Narendranath et al. 2024b). High Fe indicates mare basalt / ilmenite-bearing terrain and is anti-correlated with Al; useful for mapping mare boundaries and Fe-rich resource targets at finer resolution than LP GRS, within the limits of CLASS's track-based (non-global) coverage.
properties.lri:quality_note: Coverage is 22.05% of the grid (2021-04-01 to 2022-08-31); pixels outside CLASS ground tracks carry no measurement and are stored as NoData rather than interpolated. Fe is the binding constraint on this shared footprint mask (also used by Al, Mg, and Si), since Fe XRF lines only appear above ~C-class solar flares while Mg/Al/Si are detectable at any solar activity level.
properties.measurement_depth: tens of microns (X-ray fluorescence escape depth, true surface), much shallower than gamma-ray/neutron spectrometer techniques
properties.processing:lineage: Original Float32 GeoTIFF (ch2_cla_l2_map_fe_v1.tif) has its CRS tag reassigned from EPSG:4326 to IAU:30100 via gdal_translate (same numeric lon/lat grid, corrected body reference), NoData explicitly set to 0, and is written as COG with DEFLATE/PREDICTOR=3 compression.
